records.name: Friends of the Wissahickon
records.summary: Volunteers and members who look after the Wissahickon Valley Park in Philadelphia. They hold cleanups, help with planting and trails, and count wildlife through the year.
records.what_you_do: Join a volunteer service day, help with a cleanup, monitor habitat, or sign up as a trail ambassador.

schedule.text: Volunteer service days and cleanups happen through the year. The site does not list one regular weekly day, so check the volunteer pages for dates.

locations.label: Group office
locations.address: 40 West Evergreen Avenue, Suite 108, Philadelphia, PA 19118

first_step.how: Check the volunteer pages for the next dated opportunity, or call the office with questions
first_step.basis: Volunteer programs are listed publicly on the group's site with a phone number to ask questions

records.notes: Own site fetched 2026-10-08. The address for fow.org came from the group's name, not from a search result, and the fetched page confirmed it is the group's own site. The site lists a Saturday planting at Red Covered Bridge on October 10 without a start time; the event page was not opened. Email is on the contact page, not checked.

records.name: Friends of Poquessing Watershed
records.summary: A volunteer nonprofit that cares for Poquessing Creek across Philadelphia, Bucks and Montgomery counties. It runs monthly creek cleanups.
records.what_you_do: Join a monthly creek cleanup and help keep the stream and its banks clean.

schedule.text: Monthly cleanups. The site does not list the day, time or meeting place.

first_step.how: Call the group to ask about the next cleanup
first_step.basis: The group publishes a phone line and describes monthly cleanups, but does not say whether they are open to the public

records.notes: The site has a Monthly cleanups page, but no dates, times or places appeared on the home page, so the next cleanup is unknown. The group's email address is on the site and was left out here. No partner links to other groups were found on the page.

records.name: Philadelphia Mycology Club
records.summary: A free club of people who study mushrooms and other fungi in Philadelphia. It runs guided walks, workshops and citizen science, and joins park cleanups.
records.what_you_do: Join a guided fungus walk, learn to log finds online, or help with a park cleanup.

schedule.text: Walks, workshops and cleanups happen through the year. The club site does not list a regular day or time for cleanups.

cost.text: Membership is free, and some events are free and open to everyone

first_step.how: Email the club to ask about the next outing or cleanup
first_step.basis: The club says volunteers are welcome, membership is free, and a public contact address is published

records.notes: Own site fetched 2026-10-08 shows events dated October 25 with no year. The Cobbs Creek cleanup on the first Sunday of each month at Thomas Ave came only from a Humanitix listing (platform, lead only, credit as a lead) and a 2025 news story that returned HTTP 503, so the monthly schedule is not written here. If it still holds, the next first Sunday after 2026-10-08 is 2026-11-01. Do not confuse with Cobbs Creek Park Cleanups, a separate group that meets first Saturdays.

records.name: We Walk PHL
records.summary: A free citywide walking group run by three partners. Trained neighbors lead about one hour walks in Philadelphia parks, from one to three times a week depending on the park.
records.what_you_do: Walk with neighbors for about an hour in a park near you, led by a trained local volunteer.

schedule.text: Walks run one to three times a week depending on the park. The Bartram's Garden walk meets Thursdays, 5 to 6 pm. Season dates on the listing do not match its Thursday schedule, so check before going.

first_step.how: Find a walk near you through the program's registration link on the city page, or go to the Bartram's Garden walk
first_step.basis: Walks are free and the program says they are open to people of all ages and abilities who want to meet neighbors

records.notes: Partners are Fairmount Park Conservancy, the Philadelphia Department of Public Health and Parks & Recreation. No group website was found, so the phone number is the Schuylkill River Development Corporation's general line as published on the Bartram's Garden page. The city article (2025-09-10) lists a fall season, Sept 1 to Oct 31, and says schedules are on the program's Facebook page, which was not read. Phone number is a general line, not a program line. Sign-up need not be confirmed.

leads_only.name: Friends of Pennypack Park
leads_only.note: Monthly cleanups per 2013 to 2017 Northeast Times articles. Phone 215-934-PARK listed in old notices. The site refused the connection when checked, so no current schedule was found. Not a record yet.

leads_only.note: Inquirer roundup (undated) lists a Saturday 9:30 am cleanup at Palmer Park, Frankford Ave and E Palmer St, with phone 215-485-6698 and a Facebook page. No own website found. Not confirmed active, so not written as a record.

Check the city parks calendar and the group directly.

leads_only.note: Reported in search results as a separate volunteer group meeting the first Saturday of each month. Not opened, so not verified.
